content: Mefloquine Hydrochloride Tablets USP are an antimalarial medication formulated as 250 mg tablets of mefloquine hydrochloride, which is equivalent to 228 mg of the free base. These tablets are intended for oral administration. Mefloquine Hydrochloride USP is a derivative of 4-quinolinemethanol, with the specific chemical name (R, S)-(±)-α-2-piperidinyl-2,8-bis(trifluoromethyl)-4-quinolinemethanol hydrochloride. It is a 2-aryl substituted structural analog of quinine. The drug appears as a white to almost white crystalline compound and is only slightly soluble in water. The inactive ingredients in the formulation include colloidal silicon dioxide, corn starch, crospovidone, lactose monohydrate, magnesium stearate, microcrystalline cellulose, pregelatinized starch, poloxamer, and talc.
